title: Twice-Microwaved Potatoes
description: Just like twice-baked potatoes, except these are cooked twice in the microwave for a faster but equally tasty side dish. And there's no need to use your oven!
ingredients: 0.25 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
0.125 teaspoon seasoned salt, or to taste

steps.text: Poke potatoes all over with the tines of a fork.
Working in batches if necessary, microwave potatoes on high, turning halfway through for more even cooking, about 4 minutes per potato. Potatoes are done when they can be easily poked with a fork.
Remove potatoes from the microwave and cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out flesh with a large spoon, leaving skins intact.

Place flesh into a large, microwave-safe bowl. Stir in sour cream, processed cheese, 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese, 4 green onions, garlic powder, seasoned salt, and pepper until well combined. Microwave on high until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.
Scoop hot potato mixture back into potato skins. Garnish with remaining 1/2 cup Cheddar and 1 tablespoon green onion.
